failed_or_abandoned: First single-shot transport of 2e5 photons per run exhausted memory (exit 143) because branch populations grow at every split; replaced by 2e4-photon chunks with per-run accumulators.

First full-statistics bottom-source run exceeded the 10-minute foreground limit (photons entering through the 13.75 cm RFR split heavily); bottom and cathode sources were rerun at 0.25 and 0.3 of nominal statistics (140-440 weighted position-class records per line).

Initial pair-production table was ~2x too large (lambda(2615 keV) = 7.7 cm < lambda(2 MeV)); corrected, and the 1764/2615 keV grid runs and 2615 keV variants repeated. Runs at <= 1461 keV (including the validation and the 1461 keV variants) kept the old table (mu differs by <= 3%).

Normalising the RFR-MSSI class through the detector-ER rate over-predicts LZ's RFR expectation by ~100 in the simplified FV (73-81% of those histories sit in the bottom corner d<18 cm, z<20 cm that LZ's real contour excludes); RFR numbers are therefore normalised to LZ's 1e-4 instead.
No per-material radioassay weighting of the detector-gamma lines (not available in the paper).
